name: Xciel XCiPhone 14 Plus
statusNote: Xciel publishes a datasheet, but we found no reseller listing. Check availability with Xciel.
summary: The Xciel XCiPhone 14 Plus is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) case for the Apple iPhone 14 Plus, rated for Zone 2 under ATEX, and for Class I Division 2 in North America. The phone inside is a standard Apple iPhone 14 Plus running iOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management as other iPhones.
